text.tspan: Legislative procedure – Digitalisation and common specifications (Regulation) – COM(2025) 504 (proposal)

Procedure 2025/0134(COD). Upper part: the ordinary legislative procedure (Art. 294 TFEU); steps done (blue) and in progress (orange) as of 25 Sep 2026. Lower part: the act's procedure over time. Every event cites its source (see product-digitalisation-regulation.html).
Act adopted in the wording of the EP
approves or no decision → adopted (7a); rejects
both adopt → adopted; otherwise not adopted
Informal: trilogues of EP, Council and Commission at every stage (Joint Declaration 2007, points 7–9); a trilogue agreement confirmed by Coreper and
offered by letter to the EP committee chair (point 14) leads to adoption at first reading.
